correction: The earlier weight-space comparison chose IQ3_S over IQ3_XXS. Real MoE-block output shows the two are essentially tied, and IQ3_XXS is cheaper, so the weight-space-only conclusion is not a serving decision.
decisions: IQ3_XXS is the best 3-bit serving lane: it is statistically tied with IQ3_S in block error (0.07881 versus 0.07805) while storing 6.6 percent fewer bytes.
IQ4_XS + IQ4_NL is the recommended own-Coder arm: 40.06 percent lower block error than arm 3 for 14.29 percent more bytes.
Per-expert width mixing is not worth an engine layout change at this scale: it saves only 5.3 percent versus uniform arm 4 and loses 1.10 percent quality.
